units.source_text: 于是采用了所谓“禁闭制”。

en.t: And so the so-called confinement system was adopted.

units.source_text: 为了彻底贯彻这个制度，今天不许棋手回家，直接从红叶馆到箱根去。

en.t: In order to carry out this system thoroughly, the players were not allowed to go home today, but were sent straight from the Momijikan to Hakone.

units.source_text: 所谓“禁闭”，就是说下完一盘之前，棋手不能离开对局的地方，

en.t: Confinement meant that until a game was finished, the players could not leave the place where the match was being held,

units.source_text: 也不能会见其他的棋手，以免别人从旁当参谋。

en.t: nor could they meet other players, so as to prevent anyone from giving advice from the sidelines.

units.source_text: 虽说这样做可以保持胜负的庄严，却丧失了对人格的尊重。

en.t: Although this could preserve the solemnity of victory and defeat, it sacrificed respect for the individual.

units.source_text: 但棋手也认为这样做彼此都可以显得清高。

en.t: But the players also felt that by doing this, both sides could appear high-minded.

units.source_text: 何况这盘棋每隔五天进行一次，要连续下三个月之久。

en.t: Moreover, this match was played once every five days and would continue for as long as three months.

units.source_text: 不管参战的棋手愿不愿意，都担心第三者从旁当参谋，

en.t: Whether or not the participating players wished it, everyone worried that a third party might offer advice from the side,

units.source_text: 若有怀疑，事情就会闹大。

en.t: and if suspicion arose, the matter would become serious.

units.source_text: 当然棋手之间也存在职业道德和礼节的问题。

en.t: Of course, among the players there were also questions of professional ethics and etiquette.

units.source_text: 中途暂停尚且如此，面对对弈者就更不用说了，

en.t: If this was true even during an adjournment, then it was all the more so when facing one's opponent,

units.source_text: 必须慎之又慎，不能随意评头品足。

en.t: one had to be extremely cautious and could not make casual comments or criticisms.

units.source_text: 一旦破例，局面就不好收拾了。

en.t: Once an exception was made, the situation would become hard to manage.
